instructions.purpose: Fetch a public web page when the assistant needs the actual page contents to answer accurately.

tool.name: web-fetch
tool.description: Fetches a public http or https URL, follows validated redirects, rejects unsupported or binary content, and returns markdown, text, or HTML content with truncation metadata.

usage_rules.rule: Use this for public web URLs only; do not attempt localhost, private network, or non-http URLs.
Prefer markdown for normal reading and summarization.
Use text when the user wants plain extracted text.
Use html only when raw markup is specifically useful.
If content is truncated, say that the answer is based on the fetched portion when relevant.
Do not expose raw tool errors or JSON payloads to the user.

example.context: User asks: "Get the raw HTML for this docs page"
